questions.question:
You create a page whose `PageType` property is set to `RoleCenter`.  
  
You move through the page’s different sections.  
  
You need to add functionality to the page.  
  
What should you do?

Define the navigation menu in the area(processing).
Define the navigation bar in the area(embedding).

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Business Central.  
  
The company plans to use a translation file in an extension. The extension includes a caption that must not be translated.  
  
You need to prevent translation of the caption.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Use the CaptionML property and copy the same caption for each language used.
Set the GenerateLockedTranslations feature in the app.json file.
Add the Locked = true parameter to the Caption.
Copy the same caption for each language in the translation file.

questions.explanation:
The `Locked` parameter on an AL `Caption` property marks the caption as locked, so it should not be translated. `GenerateLockedTranslations` controls whether locked labels are generated as XLIFF translation units; it does not lock a caption itself.

**Learn more:** [Caption property - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/properties/devenv-caption-property) · [Working with translation files - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-work-with-translation-files)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Business Central.  
  
You plan to assist users with the installation process by using Assisted Setup.  
  
You need to create a wizard page.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Set the PageType property to NavigatePage.
For each step needed in the guide, add a group() control to the root-level of the layout > area(Content) control.
Set the PageType property to Worksheet.
For each step needed in the guide, add a repeater() control to the root-level of the layout > area(Content) control.

questions.explanation:
In Business Central, an Assisted Setup wizard is implemented with a page whose `PageType` is `NavigatePage`. Each wizard step is defined by a root-level `group()` control within `layout > area(Content)`; visibility logic determines which step is displayed.

**Learn more:** [Designing assisted setup guides - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-designing-navigate-pages)

questions.question:
You must add a property to the **Description** and **Comments** fields with the corresponding values for the control department manager.  
  
Which property should you add?
questions.explanation:
The `InstructionalText` property supplies placeholder guidance for a page field, such as an example or brief description of the expected input. Placeholder text is displayed only while the field is empty, so it disappears after a user enters a value.\
\
**Learn more:** [InstructionalText property - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/properties/devenv-instructionaltext-property) · [Design the prompt mode of prompt dialog page - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/copilot-design-prompt-mode)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to modify the code to satisfy the Control department’s formatting requirements for the Subcontract Document List.  
  
Which formatting should you use?
questions.explanation:
`Strong` is the bold page-field style, and `StyleExpr` conditionally applies that style when its Boolean expression is true. Applying `Style = Strong` to `Amount` with `StyleExpr = Rec.Posted = true` makes Amount bold only for posted records.

**Learn more:** [StyleExpr Property — Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/da-dk/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/properties/devenv-styleexpr-property) · [Style Property — Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/de-de/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/properties/devenv-style-property)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are developing a test codeunit for a company that uses Business Central.  
  
The company requires the following options when posting a sales order:  
  
- Ship  
- Invoice  
- Ship & Invoice  
  
You must create a test codeunit that automatically selects one of these options.  
  
You need to create the test codeunit.  
  
Which handler should you use?
questions.explanation:
A `StrMenuHandler` automates a `StrMenu` interaction. It receives the menu options and sets the integer `Choice` value for the option that the test should select, which supports selecting Ship, Invoice, or Ship & Invoice during sales-order posting.

**Learn more:** [Create handler methods - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-creating-handler-methods) · [HandlerFunctions attribute - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/attributes/devenv-handlerfunctions-attribute)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You develop an extension for the latest release of Business Central online.  
  
A customer uses an earlier on-premises release of Business Central, and the extension must be deployed to that customer's environment.  
  
You need to deploy the extension to the earlier Business Central version.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Replace the latest version of the AL Language extension with the needed earlier version.
Uninstall the AL Language extension and install the AL Language extension from the Business Central on-premises installation pack.
Change the Runtime property value of the app.json file of the app.

questions.explanation:
The `runtime` property in `app.json` specifies the Business Central runtime targeted by an extension. To publish to an earlier on-premises server, the extension's runtime must be no higher than the runtime supported by that server; setting it to the appropriate earlier version prevents use of unsupported platform capabilities.

**Learn more:** [Choose runtime version in AL - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-choosing-runtime)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company intends to set up a local Business Central Development Docker container.  
  
The environment will be used to test new project ideas.  
  
You need to ensure that the latest Business Central artifact URL is selected. Which command should you use?
questions.explanation:
The `Current` selector retrieves the currently active Business Central sandbox release. `Closest` is for selecting an artifact near a specified version, and `NextMinor` and `NextMajor` are intended for upcoming Insider releases rather than the current stable sandbox artifact.

**Learn more:** [BCContainerHelper Get-BCArtifactUrl script](https://www.powershellgallery.com/packages/BcContainerHelper/4.0.7/Content/Misc%5CGet-BCArtifactUrl.ps1) · [Running a container-based development environment - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-running-container-development)

You move through the page’s various sections.  
  
You need to add functionality to the page.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Define actions in the area(reporting) before actions in the area(creation).
Add an Activity page to display data in a graphical way.
Define the navigation bar in the area(embedding).

questions.explanation:
On a Business Central Role Center, the navigation bar is the second-level navigation that provides a flat list of links to other pages. It is defined by placing actions in `area(embedding)`. The `creation`, `processing`, and `reporting` areas are for action-bar commands, not the navigation bar.\

questions.question:
A company uses Business Central.  
  
The company plans to use the AL object model in Business Central to extend the Base Application.  
  
You need to extend the objects.  
  
Which two objects can be extended? Each correct answer provides a complete solution. (Choose two.)  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
AL provides report extensions to add to an existing report and enum extensions to add values to an existing extensible enumeration. Business Central does not support extending API pages or queries, and codeunits do not have a codeunit-extension object type.\
\
**Learn more:** [Extensibility overview - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-extensibility-overview)

questions.question:
Solution: Set the `ExcludedPermissionSets` property to Permission Set A.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Excluding a permission set removes all permissions contributed by that set from the composite permission set. Excluding Permission Set A therefore removes its Read permission, while Permission Set B still grants Insert, Modify, and Delete access to the Job table. This does not result in read-only access.\
\
**Learn more:** [ExcludedPermissionSets Property - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/properties/devenv-excludedpermissionsets-property) · [Define granular permissions - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/ui-define-granular-permissions)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure the `IncludedPermissionSets` property to Permission Set A and the `ExcludedPermissionSets` property to Permission Set B.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
For composite Business Central permission sets, excluded permissions override included permissions defined at the same level. Including `RIMD` for the Job table and excluding `IMD` removes insert, modify, and delete access, leaving only read access.\
\
**Learn more:** [Composing Permission Sets from Other Permission Sets](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-permissionset-composing)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure the `ExcludedPermissionSets` property as Permission Set B.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Excluding Permission Set B removes all permissions contributed by that set, but Permission Set A remains included and grants direct Modify and Delete permissions on the Job table. Consequently, the resulting permission set does not provide only read access. Direct and indirect permission letters are defined by the Business Central Permissions property.\
\
**Learn more:** [ExcludedPermissionSets Property — Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/properties/devenv-excludedpermissionsets-property) · [Permissions Property — Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/properties/devenv-permissions-property)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are customizing Business Central by using Visual Studio Code. You create a project that extends Business Central. The AL extension includes automatically generated JSON files that store configuration data.  
  
For testing, you plan to make these changes to the files:  
  
- Specify that page 27 opens after publishing.  
- Enable debugging.  
- Disable the ability to download the source code.  
  
You need to add the configurations to the JSON files.  
  
Which two configurations should you add? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: In the “resourceExposurePolicy” tag, set “allowDebugging”: true and “allowDownloadingSource”: false on launch.json.
In the “resourceExposurePolicy” tag, set “allowDebugging”: true and “allowDownloadingSource”: true on app.json.
In the “resourceExposurePolicy” tag, set “allowDebugging”: true and “allowDownloadingSource”: false on app.json.

questions.explanation:
The `startupObjectId` setting in `launch.json` specifies the object that opens when an AL project is published or run, so it must be set to page ID 27. The extension manifest, `app.json`, contains `resourceExposurePolicy`; `allowDebugging: true` permits debugging and `allowDownloadingSource: false` prevents downloading the extension source.

You need to create a test codeunit to execute the test.  
  
What should you use?

- Ship  
- Invoice  
- Ship & Invoice  
  
You need to create a test codeunit to execute the test.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: Change the TelemetryScope parameter to extensionpublisher.
Remove the Application Insights 2 connection string from the customer environment.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to identify why the debugger fails to start correctly.  
  
What is causing the problem?
questions.explanation:
For snapshot debugging in a Business Central cloud environment, the `userId` setting must contain the GUID of the user whose session is to be captured. A username does not identify that cloud user session, so the snapshot debugger cannot attach as intended. `WebClient` is the correct session type for a Business Central web-client session, and `DebugAndProfile` permits debugging as well as profiling.

**Learn more:** [Snapshot debugging - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-snapshot-debugging)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to invoke the Issue API action from the mobile application.  
  
Which action should you use?
questions.explanation:
A Business Central API procedure marked with `[ServiceEnabled]` is invoked as a bound action by using an HTTP `POST` request against the target entity and the fully qualified action name. With a procedure named `Copy`, the action segment is `Microsoft.NAV.Copy`; its capitalization must match the procedure name.

**Learn more:** [ServiceEnabled attribute — Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/attributes/devenv-serviceenabled-attribute) · [Introduction to automation APIs — Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/administration/itpro-introduction-to-automation-apis)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to identify whether unwanted incoming web service calls have occurred in your tenant during the past seven days.  
  
Which two KQL queries should you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Incoming Business Central web-service telemetry is identified by event ID `RT0008`, and its `category` dimension identifies the endpoint type as API, ODataV3, ODataV4, or SOAP. Because SOAP usage is being phased out, a query that filters specifically to `SOAP`, or one that excludes API, ODataV3, and ODataV4, identifies the unwanted SOAP calls during the seven-day window.

**Learn more:** [Analyzing Incoming Web Service Request Telemetry — Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/administration/telemetry-webservices-trace)

questions.domain: Integrate Business Central with other applications
questions.question:
You need to create the access modifier for `IssueTotal`.  
  
Which variable declaration should you use?
questions.explanation:
In AL, variables declared in a `protected var` section are accessible from extensions of the same table, including table extensions in dependent extensions. This permits ISSUE EXT to access `IssueTotal` on the Issue table while limiting that exposure to the table-extension context.\
\
**Learn more:** [Protected variables - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-protected-variables)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are developing an app that will be published to Microsoft AppSource.  
  
The app needs code analyzers to enforce certain rules. You plan to add the analyzers to the `settings.json` file.  
  
You need to activate the analyzers for the project.  
  
Which three code analyzers should you activate to develop the app for AppSource? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Apps published through AppSource should enable CodeCop for general AL coding guidelines, UICop for web-client UI best practices, and AppSourceCop for AppSource submission rules. PerTenantExtensionCop is for extensions installed for an individual tenant and is not used with AppSourceCop.

**Learn more:** [Use GitHub Codespaces for AL development](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-code-spaces-al) · [Using the code analysis tool](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-using-code-analysis-tool)

questions.question:
A company has a task that is completed infrequently. Users frequently need to look up the procedure to perform the task.  
  
The company requires a wizard that guides users through a sequence of steps to complete the task.  
  
You need to create the page that enables creation of the wizard.  
  
Which page type should you use?
questions.explanation:
In Business Central, a `NavigatePage` creates an assisted setup guide, also known as a wizard, that leads users through a sequence of steps for completing a task. This is designed for infrequently performed configuration or business tasks.\
\
**Learn more:** [Designing assisted setup guides](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-designing-navigate-pages) · [Pages overview - Business Central](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-pages-overview)

A company has a task that is completed infrequently. Users frequently need to look up the procedure to perform the task.  
  
The company requires a wizard that guides users through a sequence of steps to complete the task.  
  
You need to create the page that enables creation of the wizard.  
  
Which page type should you use?

options.text: Open the Visual Studio Code user settings.json file.
Add the “al.ruleSetPath” property with a path to the ruleset.json file.
Open the Visual Studio Code project settings,json file.

questions.explanation:
A project-specific ruleset changes code-analysis diagnostic severity only for that app when its path is configured in the project `settings.json` through `al.ruleSetPath`. The ruleset’s `rules` array can override the `AA0XYZ` diagnostic with the `Info` action. User settings would apply more broadly, disabling code analysis does not set a severity, and `Hidden` suppresses rather than marks the diagnostic as informational.

**Learn more:** [Ruleset for the code analysis tool](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-rule-set-syntax-for-code-analysis-tools) · [Using the code analysis tools with the ruleset](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-using-code-analysis-tool-with-rule-set)

You need values entered on the Request page to be saved for the next time the report runs.  
  
What should you do?

Declare a ‘SaveValues’ variable and assign it to true on the OnOpenPage() trigger.
Set the UseRequestPage property to true.
Set the SaveValues property to true.

Setting the request page’s `SaveValues` property to `true` saves user-entered request-page options and filters so they can be reused when the report is run again. [Microsoft Learn: Using request pages with reports](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/developer/devenv-request-pages-for-reports)\

You navigate among the page’s different sections.

What should you do?

Create headlines using the Cuegroup control.
Add a source table on the Role Center page.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are developing a view for a Business Central app.  
  
The view needs a custom layout that shows only customer records whose balance exceeds 500 in local currency.  
  
You need to configure the view to indicate that it uses a custom layout.

questions.question:
You intend to write unit-test functions for newly developed functionality in an app.  
  
You must create a test codeunit in which to write the functions.  
  
Which property should you select for the test codeunit to ensure the requirements are met?
questions.explanation:
Business Central test codeunits require the `SubType` property to be set to `Test`; this enables test methods within the codeunit. The `Access` and `Description` properties do not designate a codeunit as a test codeunit.\

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is deploying Business Central on-premises.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Business Central. Users in DepartmentA have been assigned a base application permission set.

Create an entitlement object that excludes the base application permission set.
Extend the base application permission set and configure the IncludedPermissionSets property.

questions.explanation:
Business Central permission sets provide object-level access control and can explicitly exclude an access level for a table. A tailored permission set that excludes the critical table, when assigned to the department’s users, enforces the restriction. ## Company Background

Alpine Ski House is a company that owns and operates hotels, restaurants, and stores.

Currently, the company uses the following software and interface:

- Property management software (PMS) to manage hotel rooms
- On-premises accounting software to generate sales invoices and create purchase orders
- An API that allows restaurants and stores to obtain necessary information
- Restaurants and stores use standalone software for point of sale (POS) devices. Each day, the POS terminals generate a text file of sales data and save the files in a server folder. An account assistant must manually import the files to the current software tables to be processed by the system.
- The general manager receives several reports monthly from department managers. The reports take too much time to prepare.

## Planned improvements

The company is moving from a different system to Business Central online to manage the whole company.

The company plans to improve efficiency in every department by using APIs to obtain or share information between the different systems.

Each department involved in purchasing must be able to create purchase requests automatically and easily. The departments do not need access to the full ERP management system.

## Technical specifications

Alpine Ski House requires several extensions to be developed for the planned improvements. Business Central design patterns must be used to develop all extensions.

Alpine Ski House must develop the following pages:

- Pages that provide multiple configurations in a multistep dialog, like a wizard, to provide required information when the extensions are first installed
- Department-specific Role Center pages to show relevant information and pages with additional information

The IT department plans to use Power BI to analyze departmental information. The database must be configured to provide optimal performance.

## Department-specific requirements. Housekeeping department

The housekeeping department requires the following to improve efficiency and help avoid data entry errors:

- A Housekeeping Role Center to reduce navigation to relevant areas in Business Central online and to show relevant information in it
- Pages to embed into a new Room page to show additional information about the Room entity
- A table named Room Incident for the housekeeping team to enter room issue information
- A Housekeeping canvas app that connects to an extension

The department requires the development of an extension with a new API page named RoomsAPI.

The housekeeping team will use RoomsAPI to publish room details, update when work is complete, or provide repair notifications from the canvas app.

This custom API page must expose a custom table named Rooms and have an ID 50000. The table must be able to update from the PMS. The PMS team must know the endpoint to connect to the custom API.

A developer provides the following details for the API page:

![Scenario Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1784083176268-izkyltnr.png)

The extension must be published in Business Central online and include a list page named Room List that includes all hotel rooms.

Installation or updates to this extension must meet the following requirements:

- Some web services must be published automatically.
- The version of the specified application's metadata must be obtained in AL language.
- The code required to perform tasks cannot be accessible from other parts of the application.

The Room Incident table information must include the following fields:

- Incident entry: An incremental number
- Room No.: A room from the Room table
- Incident Date: The work date

The table definition in the Room Incident table must autofill the Incident Date when the housekeeping team inserts a new record.

The value for Incident Date must be the work date configured in the Business Central online client.

- Status: Includes the following options to identify the status of the incident:
  - Open: When the Room Incident is created
  - In Progress: When someone starts repair work
  - Closed: When the incident is solved
- Incident Closing Date: Auto-updating field (when the status passes to Closed, the field will update with the work date)
- Incident Description: Text
- Image: Media data type

The stored picture must be downloadable from a menu action.

A Room Incident page must be developed to contain the download action.

## Department-specific requirements. Restaurants and stores

To improve efficiency, the new system must handle the generated data from the restaurants and stores directly by using the API on the POS terminals.

The company requires a codeunit called from a job queue to read the information from the POS terminal APIs.

The POS terminal information must be stored in a table named POS Information, have an ID 50100, and be editable on a page.

The account manager requires an option on the page menu to run the process manually.

To analyze the information received from the POS terminals, the company requires:

- A custom API named ticketAPI to export the information to Power BI
- Use of the Read Scale-Out feature to improve database performance

## Department-specific requirements and non-conformity handling

The purchasing department requires a new entity in Business Central online to log non-conformities of goods received from vendors. The entity must be set up as follows:

- The non-conformity entity must have two tables:
  - a header with common information
  - one or more lines with the detailed received items that are non-conforming
- The entity requires a page named Non-conformity and a subpage named Non-conformity Lines to store the information.

When a purchase order with incorrect quantity or quality issues is received, the entity must create a non-conformity document in the system. The following information must be included in the document:

- Non-conformity Number: must use the No. Series table from Business Central online to manage this field and use these features:
  - Alphanumeric values
  - Number format that includes “NC” and the year as part of the number; for example, NC24-001
- Non-conformity Date: stores only the creation date
- Vendor No.: stores the number of the vendor that sent the items; only vendors from the company must be included
- Owner: code of an employee defined in the company
- Receipt No.: must meet the following conditions:
  - Be an existing receipt No.
  - Be received from the vendor indicated in the Vendor No. field
- Comments: can include comments with rich text and pictures to illustrate quality problems
- Status: includes non-conformity statuses, such as:
  - Open
  - Notified
  - Closed

Lines must contain the following details:

- Item No.: item received (for existing inventory items only)
- Description: item description
- Quantity: non-conforming quantity
- Non-conformity Type:
  - Quality
  - Quantity
- Delivery date

You need to define the tables that are used for the non-conformity entity.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: document history table to introduce the non-conformity entities
document table to introduce the non-conformity entities
supplemental table to introduce the non-conformity lines

questions.explanation:
A non-conformity is a transaction that has shared document-level information and one or more detail lines. Business Central document tables use a document header for information common to all lines and document lines for the detailed transaction data. Supplemental tables are supporting reference tables rather than transaction-line tables.\
\

You need to make sure that an application fulfills the technical requirements before submitting it for validation.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer presents a complete solution. (Choose three.)  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Ensure the .app file is digitally signed.
Use the OnBeforeCompanyOpen event for improved sign in time.
Use data classification on all tables and extension fields.
Include extension translation files with the submission.
Code all date fields in the mm-dd-yyyy format.

questions.explanation:
Business Central AppSource technical validation requires the .app package to be digitally signed, DataClassification to be set for fields in tables and table extensions, and translation files to be used in the submitted extension. The OnBeforeCompanyOpen event is not permitted because it can impair performance, and AL date literals must use the nonregional `yyyymmddD` format rather than `mm-dd-yyyy`.
